phrases.english: Not this way; we’re going the other way.

phrases.latin: ut ventum est in trivium, eādem quā cēterī fugere nōluit … cum quidem iī, quī aliā viā fūgerant, in hostium equitātum incidērunt
phrases.english: when they came to a fork in the road, he refused to flee the same way as the rest … and those who had fled by the other road ran into the enemy’s cavalry

phrases.latin: Mē captās, quia tūte ab nāvī clanculum hūc aliā viā praecucurristī
phrases.english: You’re trying to catch me out, because you yourself ran on ahead here from the ship by another way, on the quiet

sources: Lewis & Short: alius
The grouped card gave no source for this word.
